'''el'Leanna ti Arathdar Mandragoran''' was the wife of [[al'Akir Mandragoran]], and the mother of [[al'Lan Mandragoran]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Leanna ti Arathdar Mandragoran}}

== History ==
Leanna was born to [[House Arathdar]], and married into [[House Mandragoran]] with her marriage to al'Akir.{{ref|[[Origins of the Wheel of Time]], Revision 23 - Family Tree}} They had a son and heir, Lan.

She and her husband, [[al'Akir Mandragoran]], sent [[al'Lan Mandragoran]] out of dying Malkier when he was born. They both were killed at [[Herot's Crossing]] soon after.
